sourceNote: Ideas derived from gaps in the Sui ecosystem compared to Ethereum and Solana. Each idea identifies a proven category that has no Sui-native equivalent or is underbuilt on Sui.

ideas.title: Concentrated liquidity AMM with single-sided deposits
ideas.summary: AMM that supports concentrated liquidity ranges with single-sided deposits. Reduces IL risk for passive LPs compared to full-range positions.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model tracks individual LP positions as objects. PTBs enable atomic range adjustments.
ideas.marketSignal: Uniswap v3 concentrated liquidity dominates DEX volume. Sui AMMs are still mostly full-range.

ideas.title: Full-featured blockchain explorer with analytics dashboards
ideas.summary: Sui explorer with address profiling, token flow visualization, whale tracking, and custom dashboards. Goes beyond raw transaction display.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model enables richer per-object analytics than account-based chains.
ideas.marketSignal: Etherscan, Solscan, and Arkham have millions of monthly users. Sui explorers lack analytics depth.

ideas.title: Decentralized compute marketplace for AI workloads
ideas.summary: GPU providers list capacity on Sui. Buyers reserve compute via PTBs. Job completion verified through Nautilus TEE attestation.
ideas.fitForSui: Nautilus TEE verifies job completion. Sui objects track compute reservations. PTBs handle atomic payment on delivery.
ideas.marketSignal: Akash, Render Network prove decentralized compute demand. No Sui-native equivalent exists.

ideas.title: Decentralized DNS with censorship-resistant resolution
ideas.summary: DNS records stored as Sui objects. Resolution via Walrus-hosted zone files. Extends SuiNS from name registration to full DNS replacement.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent DNS records natively. Walrus stores zone files. SuiNS provides the naming layer.
ideas.marketSignal: ENS has 2M+ registrations. Handshake proved DNS decentralization demand. SuiNS covers naming but not full DNS.

ideas.title: Decentralized insurance protocol for smart contract risk
ideas.summary: Users buy cover against smart contract exploits, oracle failures, or bridge hacks. Claims adjudicated by token-weighted governance.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent individual policies with rich state. PTBs handle claim payouts atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: Nexus Mutual covers $500M+ on EVM. InsurAce on multiple chains. No Sui-native insurance exists.

ideas.title: Decentralized VPN with Sui-based bandwidth payments
ideas.summary: VPN node operators sell bandwidth. Users pay per-MB via streaming Sui payments. Traffic routing verified by Nautilus TEE.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's high throughput handles micro-payments for bandwidth. Nautilus TEE verifies traffic routing.
ideas.marketSignal: Orchid, Mysterium prove decentralized VPN demand. VPN market is $50B+ annually.

ideas.title: Unified DeFi portfolio tracker for all Sui protocols
ideas.summary: Single dashboard showing positions across Scallop, NAVI, Cetus, Aftermath, DeepBook, and all Sui DeFi. Real-time PnL tracking.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model makes position tracking per-object. Can read all protocol state from a single RPC endpoint.
ideas.marketSignal: Zapper and DeBank have millions of users on EVM. No comprehensive Sui portfolio tracker exists.

ideas.title: Secondary marketplace for SuiNS domains
ideas.summary: Dedicated marketplace for buying, selling, and auctioning SuiNS domains. Price discovery, bulk listing, and domain appraisal tools.
ideas.fitForSui: SuiNS domains are Sui objects traded via Kiosk. Transfer policies enforce royalties on resale.
ideas.marketSignal: ENS domains trade $100M+ annually on secondary markets. SuiNS has no dedicated trading venue.

ideas.title: Flash loan protocol for Sui
ideas.summary: Atomic flash loans that borrow and repay within a single PTB. Enables arbitrage, liquidation, and collateral swaps without upfront capital.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs are the perfect primitive for flash loans. Borrow, use, and repay in one atomic transaction.
ideas.marketSignal: Aave flash loans process $10B+ monthly on EVM. No dedicated Sui flash loan protocol exists.

ideas.title: Modular governance framework for Sui projects
ideas.summary: Drop-in governance module for any Sui project. Proposal creation, token-weighted voting, timelock execution, and delegation.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent proposals and votes. Capabilities scope execution authority. PTBs execute approved actions.
ideas.marketSignal: OpenZeppelin Governor and Compound governance serve thousands of DAOs on EVM. No Sui equivalent exists.

ideas.title: On-chain index fund tracking Sui ecosystem tokens
ideas.summary: Tokenized index of top Sui tokens by TVL or volume. Auto-rebalances on a schedule. Single token gives exposure to the whole ecosystem.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs rebalance across multiple DEXs atomically. Sui objects track individual fund share positions.
ideas.marketSignal: TokenSets and Index Coop on EVM manage $100M+. No Sui-native index product exists.

ideas.title: Liquid staking aggregator across Sui validators
ideas.summary: Deposit SUI, receive a liquid staking token. Aggregator distributes stake across top validators for optimal yield and decentralization.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's native staking plus PTBs enable atomic deposit and token minting. Object model tracks per-user stake.
ideas.marketSignal: Lido on ETH holds $30B+ TVL. Sui liquid staking is nascent with room for a dominant player.

ideas.title: Package registry and dependency manager for Move
ideas.summary: npm-style registry for Move packages. Versioning, dependency resolution, security audits, and one-command installation.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui Move packages need a proper registry. MVR provides naming but not full dependency management.
ideas.marketSignal: npm, crates.io, and pip serve millions of developers. Move ecosystem has no equivalent.

ideas.title: NFT fractionalization protocol for Sui objects
ideas.summary: Lock a high-value Sui object, mint fungible fraction tokens. Fraction holders govern the underlying asset. Buyout mechanism for full acquisition.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's object model plus Kiosk transfer policies make fractionalization cleaner than ERC-721 wrapping.
ideas.marketSignal: Fractional Art (now Tessera) and PartyBid proved NFT fractionalization demand on EVM.

ideas.title: On-chain reputation system with composable scores
ideas.summary: Protocol-agnostic reputation scores computed from on-chain activity. Apps query reputation via capability reads. Users control visibility.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects carry reputation state directly. Capability-scoped reads protect privacy. Cross-app composability is native.
ideas.marketSignal: DegenScore, Gitcoin Passport prove on-chain reputation demand. No Sui-native reputation protocol exists.

ideas.title: Automated options vaults selling covered calls on Sui
ideas.summary: Vaults that earn yield by selling covered calls on SUI and other tokens. Auto-rolls weekly. Depositors earn premium.
ideas.fitForSui: DeepBook settles option trades. PTBs handle atomic vault deposit and option writing.
ideas.marketSignal: Ribbon Finance and Friktion had $1B+ TVL at peak. No Sui-native options vault exists.

ideas.title: Payment request protocol for invoicing on Sui
ideas.summary: Merchant creates a payment request object. Buyer pays via any method (stablecoin, SUI, swap). Request settles atomically. Receipt issued as an object.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs enable swap-and-pay in one transaction. Sui objects represent invoices and receipts natively.
ideas.marketSignal: Request Network on EVM processes $100M+ in invoices. No Sui-native invoicing exists.

ideas.title: Sports prediction market with real-time settlement
ideas.summary: Prediction market focused on sports outcomes. Pyth or custom oracle feeds resolve markets. Sub-minute settlement on Sui.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's parallel execution handles high-frequency bet settlement. DeepBook provides order matching for share trading.
ideas.marketSignal: Sports betting is a $200B+ global market. Polymarket proved crypto prediction markets work.

ideas.title: Social trading platform with copy-trade vaults
ideas.summary: Follow top traders and mirror their Sui DeFi positions. Leader strategies are vaults. Followers deposit and auto-replicate trades.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs replicate multi-step trades atomically. Sui objects track leader and follower positions separately.
ideas.marketSignal: eToro manages $30B+ via social trading. Perpy on EVM proved on-chain copy trading.

ideas.title: Stablecoin yield optimizer across Sui lending protocols
ideas.summary: Deposit USDC once. Protocol auto-routes across Scallop, NAVI, and Suilend for the best rate. Rebalances when rates shift.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs route across multiple protocols atomically. Sponsored upkeep transactions auto-rebalance.
ideas.marketSignal: Yearn stablecoin vaults hold $500M+ TVL. No Sui-native stablecoin optimizer exists.

ideas.title: Token streaming protocol for salaries and subscriptions
ideas.summary: Stream SUI or stablecoins per-second to recipients. Cancel or adjust rates in real time. Handles payroll, subscriptions, and vesting.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's clock module and shared objects enable per-second payment streaming. PTBs adjust streams atomically.
ideas.marketSignal: Sablier and Superfluid process $500M+ in streamed payments on EVM. No Sui-native equivalent.

ideas.title: DEX aggregator routing across all Sui liquidity sources
ideas.summary: Split-route swaps across Cetus, Aftermath, Turbos, DeepBook, and any new DEX. Finds best execution price automatically.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs execute split-route swaps atomically in one transaction. No router contract needed per DEX.
ideas.marketSignal: Jupiter on Solana is the #1 DeFi app by users. 1inch on EVM processes billions monthly. No Sui aggregator dominates.

ideas.title: Token vesting and lockup management platform
ideas.summary: Create vesting schedules, lockups, and cliff releases for token allocations. Dashboard for investors, teams, and communities to track vesting.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent individual vesting schedules with rich state. Clock module triggers releases.
ideas.marketSignal: Hedgey and Sablier serve thousands of projects on EVM. No Sui-native vesting platform exists.

ideas.title: Transaction simulation and preview tool for Sui
ideas.summary: Preview exactly what a Sui transaction will do before signing. Show token transfers, object changes, and approval requests in plain language.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's deterministic execution makes simulation reliable. Object-level diffs are more intuitive than EVM state diffs.
ideas.marketSignal: Blowfish and Pocket Universe on EVM have millions of users. Sui wallets lack transaction preview.

ideas.title: Protocol treasury analytics and reporting dashboard
ideas.summary: Track treasury holdings, runway, revenue, and expenses for Sui protocols. Export for governance proposals and investor reports.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects holding treasury funds can be read directly. No off-chain indexing needed for basic reporting.
ideas.marketSignal: DeepDAO tracks 30K+ DAOs. TokenTerminal covers protocol financials. No Sui-focused treasury tool exists.

ideas.title: Under-collateralized lending with on-chain credit scoring
ideas.summary: Lending protocol that uses on-chain activity history to offer reduced collateral requirements. Reputation-based credit lines.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects carry borrower credit history. Capabilities scope what lenders can read. Move enforces repayment.
ideas.marketSignal: Goldfinch, Maple, and TrueFi proved under-collateralized demand on EVM ($2B+ originated).

ideas.title: Wallet-as-a-service API for Sui app developers
ideas.summary: API that lets any app create and manage Sui wallets for users. No wallet popups, no seed phrases. Users interact through the app's UI.
ideas.fitForSui: zkLogin plus sponsored transactions enable invisible wallet creation. Sui's UX stack is the most wallet-as-a-service-ready L1.
ideas.marketSignal: Privy, Dynamic, and Magic on EVM serve thousands of apps. Sui lacks a dedicated WaaS provider.

ideas.title: Yield-bearing stablecoin backed by Sui DeFi
ideas.summary: Mint a stablecoin that automatically earns yield from Sui lending protocols. Holders receive yield without active management.
ideas.fitForSui: PTBs route collateral across Scallop, NAVI atomically. Sui objects track individual holder positions.
ideas.marketSignal: sDAI on EVM holds $2B+. No Sui-native yield-bearing stablecoin exists.

ideas.title: ZK identity verification layer for Sui apps
ideas.summary: Prove age, nationality, or accreditation via ZK proofs without revealing personal data. Apps query identity claims via capability-gated reads.
ideas.fitForSui: Move contracts verify ZK proofs on-chain. Capabilities scope what identity claims each app can read.
ideas.marketSignal: Polygon ID and Worldcoin prove ZK identity demand. No Sui-native ZK identity layer exists.

ideas.title: Automated airdrop distribution tool for Sui tokens
ideas.summary: Upload CSV of recipients. Tool generates Merkle tree, deploys claim contract, and handles gas-sponsored claims. Dashboard tracks claim rates.
ideas.fitForSui: Sponsored transactions let recipients claim without gas. PTBs batch multiple claims. Sui objects track claim state.
ideas.marketSignal: Disperse.app and Thirdweb airdrop tools serve thousands of projects on EVM. No Sui equivalent exists.

ideas.title: Bridge aggregator for cheapest cross-chain transfers to Sui
ideas.summary: Compare routes across Wormhole, LayerZero, and other bridges. Find the cheapest, fastest path to move assets to Sui. One-click execution.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's growing DeFi ecosystem needs inbound liquidity. Bridge aggregation reduces friction for new capital.
ideas.marketSignal: Li.Fi and Socket on EVM aggregate billions in bridge volume. No Sui-focused bridge aggregator exists.

ideas.title: Move contract source verification and registry
ideas.summary: Verify that deployed Move bytecode matches published source. Registry of verified packages. Badge system for audited code.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui Move packages need a verification layer similar to Etherscan's contract verification. Builds trust in DeFi protocols.
ideas.marketSignal: Etherscan verification is table stakes on EVM. Sui has no equivalent verification service.

ideas.title: DeFi notification service for Sui positions
ideas.summary: Push notifications for health factor warnings, reward claims, governance votes, large price moves, and custom conditions. Mobile and Telegram support.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's event system emits structured data for position monitoring. Objects carry all state needed for condition checks.
ideas.marketSignal: HAL and Notifi serve millions of users on EVM. Sui DeFi users lack notification infrastructure.

ideas.title: Fiat off-ramp API for Sui app developers
ideas.summary: API that lets Sui dapps offer USD, EUR, or local currency cashout. User sells tokens on-chain, receives fiat via bank transfer or mobile money.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui's sponsored transactions and zkLogin make the sell-to-fiat flow seamless. No wallet complexity for the end user.
ideas.marketSignal: MoonPay and Transak serve thousands of dapps on EVM. Sui fiat off-ramp options are limited.

ideas.title: Loyalty points infrastructure for Sui protocols
ideas.summary: Shared loyalty point system that multiple Sui protocols participate in. Users earn points across DeFi, NFTs, and gaming. Redeemable for rewards.
ideas.fitForSui: Sui objects represent loyalty balances. Capabilities scope which protocols can grant or burn points.
ideas.marketSignal: Points programs (EigenLayer, Blast) drove billions in TVL. No shared Sui-native points infrastructure exists.

ideas.title: Multi-chain wallet with Sui as the primary chain
ideas.summary: Wallet that supports Sui, EVM, and Solana with Sui-first UX. Cross-chain swaps and bridges built in. zkLogin for Sui accounts.
ideas.fitForSui: zkLogin gives the best onboarding UX on any chain. Making Sui the primary chain introduces users to Sui ecosystem first.
ideas.marketSignal: Phantom expanded from Solana to multi-chain and now has 15M+ users. Sui wallets are Sui-only.

ideas.title: NFT rental protocol for gaming and utility assets
ideas.summary: Rent Sui NFTs for a fixed period without transferring ownership. Use cases: game items, domain names, memberships. Kiosk transfer policies enforce return.
ideas.fitForSui: Kiosk transfer policies can enforce rental terms at the protocol layer. Sui objects track rental state per-item.
ideas.marketSignal: ReNFT on EVM processed 50K+ rentals. Gaming and utility NFT rentals are a growing use case.
